issues: Hydration console warning: React 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — caused by Emergent's build-time instrumentation wrapping <option> children with a <span data-ve-dynamic>. Not user-visible, but pollutes console. Can be ignored or wrapped differently in the map key/expression.

critical_code_review_comments: routes_consulting._available_credits counts enrollments with source!='free' as granting credit — correct per spec. Note edge case: if an enrollment doc is later deleted/refunded, the corresponding used credit could go negative; max(0, granted-consumed) hides it. Consider tracking explicit credit ledger long-term.
admin_set_config always sets weeks_ahead=4 (spec-compliant), but ignores any client-provided value silently — acceptable.
admin_reject and cancel do not lock: an approved booking can be rejected which frees the credit. This is used for cleanup and matches spec, but you may want an audit log.

Reschedule uses window.prompt (three prompts) — spec-consistent but not automatable in Playwright without dialog handlers; consider a small modal for better UX + testability (add propose-date-input, propose-time-input, propose-submit).
